en.Toyota Production System (TPS), İkinci D: Toyota Production System (TPS) is the management system developed under the leadership of Taiichi Ohno after World War II and forms the basis of Toyota's production philosophy. Its aim is to eliminate waste (muda) and provide the highest quality to the customer at the lowest cost and in the shortest time. It forms the basis of the approach applied today in many sectors around the world called "lean manufacturing".
